_zh.summary: 湘菜小馆，开在 Doncaster Village Ave。门口挂着「走进联合国的湘菜代表」「全国湘菜名店 50 强」三块牌子。
_zh.summaryEn: A Hunan kitchen on Village Ave, Doncaster — the plaques at the door read “Hunan cuisine at the United Nations” and “Top 50 Hunan restaurants”.
_zh.lede: 现炒现做，辣度可以商量。午市晚市都开，堂食、外带、大桌聚餐都接。
_zh.ledeEn: Cooked to order, heat to taste. Lunch and dinner, seven days — dine in, takeaway, or a big table for the family.

_menu.blurb: 辣椒、蒜片、黄牛肉。一口下去是湖南的火气，不是澳洲改良的甜口。
_menu.blurbEn: Chilli, sliced garlic, yellow beef — cooked the way Hunan cooks it, not softened for the suburbs.

_menu.en: Pork ribs with blistered green chilli
